description: This file manages UI settings, including loading, saving, and handling session tokens and gateway URLs. It defines types, constants, and functions for persisting user preferences and session data in local storage, with support for scoped and legacy keys.

methods.name: settingsKeyForGateway
methods.description: Generates a scoped key for storing settings based on the gateway URL.

methods.name: snapBorderRadius
methods.description: Snaps a border radius value to the nearest predefined stop.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads UI settings from local storage, applying defaults and handling legacy data.

methods.name: saveSettings
methods.description: Persists the given UI settings to local storage.
